item.title: PyPad 2.0.1
item.description: - PyPad 2.0.1 continues the accessibility-first desktop UX, serious editor workflows, and stronger modular architecture introduced in 2.0.0. - New compare and merge workflow, structured data tools, Large File Mode banner, named sessions, macro library manager, and upgraded local history review. - New split-view polish, portable mode storage support, workspace insights, and clearer plugin health reporting. - Main editor UX now better reflects a production-ready desktop tool with stronger status feedback, more intentional layouts, and clearer review flows. - This release is intended to stand out as a major milestone rather than a routine maintenance update. - Detailed changelog: CHANGELOG.md
